title: Full adversarial review of the Story 1.3 readiness + completion-monitor increment
summary: One full adversarial sweep (fresh session, review-only, never the implementer) of the ~4,700-line Story 1.3 increment: four independent readiness scopes and their isolation, offline-default purity against the frozen 1.1 no-external-binary assertions, bounded non-authoritative live probes, exact-route refusal without substitution, validator anti-vacuity and the new VALIDATOR_VERDICT_UNAVAILABLE exit mapping, credential non-exposure, the new completion monitor and provenance-bound cleanup with their eleven required regressions, read-only orchestration bridge, JSON/human parity and exit semantics, schema-to-contract vocabulary exactness, frozen 1.1/1.2/orchestration gate intactness, gate-genuineness and falsifiability-control verification against retained gate logs. Verdict bound to the frozen blocker bar (frozen-requirement violation + reproduced + reachable); classification-first; runnable attack scripts as evidence.
